questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Titans or Rhinos?
Which of these players went on to be a match referee in a women's test match?
questions.explanation: Fritz was the match referee in the test match between South Africa and England, December 2024.

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
At which ground did Audrey Petersen record their career-best innings (60, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl, against Badgers on 2006/01/14.

questions.question: At which ground did Tuskers record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval — highest total of 137, against Rhinos on 2015/03/15.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most 5-Wicket Hauls' in the 19/20 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Jané Winster holds it, with a total of 2.
